##### Project general facts

Aqua Arc by BNW Developments is a refined waterfront residential building whose contemporary architecture is inspired by the fluid elegance of the sea. Signature wave-like balconies and a sculptural facade create a striking visual identity while enhancing natural light, views and outdoor living. The building rises above a basement and a ground floor to twelve residential floors, with expansive terraces throughout and select premium residences featuring private pools for added privacy.

Residents enjoy a rooftop pool with views over the sea, a fully equipped gym and a steam room and sauna for everyday wellness. An amphitheatre, recreational areas, walking trails, a barbecue area and a children's play area create welcoming spaces for families and friends, while the calm, resort-like atmosphere of the building offers a peaceful retreat combined with easy access to the beaches, hotels and dining venues nearby.

Interiors are fully finished with modern, high-quality materials, showcasing meticulous craftsmanship and a refined design approach. Kitchens come equipped with built-in appliances, while spacious layouts enhance comfort and practicality. Homes are delivered fully furnished, offering a turnkey living experience where every detail is curated for elegance and convenience, ideal for owner-occupiers and holiday-home investors alike.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a man-made archipelago off the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, made up of four coral-shaped islands connected by a central boulevard. Long stretches of white sandy beach, luxury resorts, waterfront restaurants and upscale residences make it one of the most popular leisure destinations in the northern emirates, with calm waters ideal for swimming and water sports.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Salem Road and Emirates Road connect the island with Ras Al Khaimah city, Dubai and the other emirates. The beach clubs and resorts of the island are within walking distance, Al Hamra Village, Al Hamra Mall and the golf course are a short drive away, and Ras Al Khaimah International Airport and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance.

Al Marjan Island is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the fastest-growing waterfront markets in the UAE. The opening of a major integrated resort and a steady flow of tourists support strong demand for furnished holiday homes. Beachfront living, accessible prices compared with Dubai and attractive short-stay rental returns underpin long-term value for investors.
